description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to network bridge mode and IGMP snooping settings within a web UI. It checks user session, updates device configuration via setStr calls, and returns JSON-encoded status.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration parameter on the device.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration parameter from the device.
